description:
One legal position, with its text and published markup.

Pass a search hit's `position_id`. `text` is plain, `text_html` as published.

`norm_refs` dates each statute quoted to the `ua_law` edition then in force,
with a `urn` `ua_law__get_unit_fulltext` takes, to compare with today's text.

`departs_from`/`departed_in` link departures, read from position texts;
`history` has the detail. `approved_at` is NOT a publication date: its absence
says nothing about whether a position is current.
name: ua_lpd__position
title: Get Supreme Court Legal Position
